checks.name: G1_flat_control_recovers_arbitrary_N
checks.msg: R=0: N=1,2,3 discrete and both continuum measures passive over 80-pt grid; no curvature needed to admit any N

checks.name: G2_curvature_deforms_each_mode_independently
checks.msg: per-mode curvature coupling changes chi'' by up to 0.72 rel; common coupling keeps all N passive: deformation allowed, selection not forced

checks.name: G3_ward_fixes_residue_structure_not_poles
checks.msg: Ward/diffeo constraints act on the tensor character of each residue (which covariant operator it multiplies); arbitrary positive residue reassignment keeps every admissible spectrum covariant

checks.name: G4_ep_distinguishes_but_forbids_no_N
checks.msg: local response N1 vs N2 differs by 0.179 at fixed curvature — empirically distinguishable, yet EP/universal-coupling admits all of N=1,2,3,infty (EP constrains the drive's coupling, not the response spectrum)

checks.name: G5_covariant_minimal_realization_all_N
checks.msg: each mode embeds as a massive scalar constitutive field (Box+m^2)phi=J, m^2=1/tau^2>0, retarded support inside light cone; continuum realized as mass-weighted integral of the same fields: covariance excludes no N

checks.name: G6_no_pathology_triggered_by_N_itself
checks.msg: ghost (negative residue) fails passivity and tachyonic m^2<0 fails causal retarded support INDEPENDENT of N; with positive weights any N is ghost-free, causal, conserved

checks.name: G7_geometry_parameterizes_spectrum_does_not_select
checks.msg: VERDICT: curvature allows rho(tau) -> rho(tau;x) as a parameterization via per-mode couplings c_i R, but no covariant requirement (Ward, EP, conservation, causality) fixes the number of modes, their weights, or their times: the memory spectrum is an EMPIRICAL STRUCTURAL INPUT to GRUT

checks.name: GFRAME_geometry_constrains_coupling_not_spectral_content
checks.msg: one-pole and two-pole media obey identical covariant/conservation/EP requirements in the same curved background yet give 0.29 relative local-response difference: geometry constrains HOW modes couple, not WHICH/HOW MANY modes exist

checks.name: CONTROL_instrument_discriminates_nonphysical
checks.msg: ghost residue fails passivity (residual negative); tachyonic mode fails causal-support test: the instrument discriminates

verdict: Geometry does NOT select the memory spectrum. Curvature permits per-mode parameterization tau_i(x) and constrains residue tensor structure, but Ward identities, equivalence principle, conservation and causal retarded support admit N = 1, 2, 3, and infty equally. After eliminating temporal response axioms and equilibrium thermodynamics, the memory spectrum is an empirical structural input to GRUT.
